support_policy: 10.0.0 release. Existing 7.0+ tunnels keep API v1 compatibility. Remote control requires matching advertised server/host capabilities and signed grants; remote-control payloads use authenticated, end-to-end DTLS UDP, preferring direct P2P with an optional server UDP TURN relay for browser viewers and no TCP fallback. Formal publication requires the frozen api-v1.4.0 contract and reviewed acceptance receipts bound to the candidate packages; owner-waived items are disclosed and unverified. FRP keeps its independent upstream version.
